equipmentAndSuppliesPerTv.notes: User-specified combined equipment and supplies assumption; not a supplier SKU price or a replacement for catalog specifications.

additionalJobAllowance.notes: User-confirmed combined modeled TV-only job allowance replacing separate travel/shipping deductions. Verify actual coverage before approval.

costModel.notes: Only jobs entirely consisting of 56-65-inch TVs with Home2Smart fixed mounts use this model. Other sizes, customer mounts, camera/mixed jobs retain existing costing. Tax 8%, processing 3%, reserve 5%, commission 55% from inherited assumptions; no owner installation labor.

tvSuppliesPerTv.notes: Existing extra_tv_consumables catalog estimate per TV; not an approved camera allowance.

cameraSuppliesPerCamera.notes: No approved camera consumable allowance supplied.

solarChargingPerCamera.notes: Verify compatible included/available charging supplies; do not assume zero.

travelPerVisit.notes: Enter site-specific travel expense, including any expected travel costs.

shippingPerVisit.notes: Verify supplier shipping charges; free shipping requires documented zero.

overhead.notes: Enter monthly operating overhead separately; never deduct owner installation labor.

assumptions.notes: Planning assumptions only. Taxability requires local verification. Service reserve is retained but unavailable for modeled commission/distributions; no second reserve deduction. No technician payroll or owner installation labor is deducted.
